description: This file defines a generic command class 'ScenarioCommand<T>' for handling scenario execution in a distributed testing framework, including setting up command-line options and a static factory method for creating commands. It also defines a static class 'Scenario' with a method to create instances of 'ScenarioCommand<T>'.

classes.name: ScenarioCommand<T>
classes.description: A command class for executing load generator scenarios with specified parameters.

methods.name: CreateCommand
methods.description: A static method to create a new 'ScenarioCommand<T>' instance with specified scenario and logger factory.
